purpose: Identify current costly native recovery location; no physics/register writes and no performance ranking
mechanism: PTRACE_ATTACH, wait for stop, PTRACE_GETREGS read instruction pointer only, PTRACE_DETACH immediately; no register or memory writes
timing_scope: Actual observed attach/stop/detach times retained; any pause contaminates native elapsed wall-clock cost. Concurrent study costs already descriptive only.
decline: If ptrace is denied or process has ended, retain the actual error; do not infer a solver function or retry against another PID. Never kill or manufacture terminal study outcome.
